title: aye jaane dile haidare karrar alamdar
body:
aye jaane dile haidare karrar alamdar
alamdar alamdar
aye quwate sibte shahe abraar alamdar
alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
ta hashr teri yaad zamane me rahegi
aye sarware aalam ke wafadar alamdar
marne se tere lashkare sheh hogaya barbaad
aye meri musibat ke madadgaar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhlaado phir ek baar mujhe chaand si surat
marta hai tera talibe deedar alamdar
darya se utho bhai ki imdaad ko aao
tanha hai ye ab bekaso nachaar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hai sakina use do aake dilasa
saqqaye sakina mere jarrar alamdar
jab tak safe matam meri dunya me bichegi
royenge tujhe mere azadar alamdar
